voice.copyfail: The flour slipped - select the code instead
voice.hero.h1:
A design system
drawn at the threshold
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, on a floor washed before sunrise. Each page has its own kolam, drawn fresh each day; stay a while and the ants come.
voice.lede.worlds: One system, many worlds. In this one the page is a threshold: rice flour on washed stone by night, kaavi on lime wash by day, and a kolam at every door.
voice.lede.typography: Arima draws the titles with a calligraphic warmth; Hind Madurai carries the reading; IBM Plex Mono keeps labels and numbers steady.
voice.lede.colour: Measured from real things: the stone floor, rice flour, kaavi brick paste, arakku red, turmeric and a slate-indigo wall. The dark theme is the floor before sunrise; the light theme is lime wash in full morning.
voice.lede.spacing: Room around everything, the way a kolam leaves the floor around it clear.
voice.lede.radius: Soft corners, like worn stone steps.
voice.lede.elevation: Sheets of lime-washed card on the floor; a shadow only where something is lifted.
voice.lede.motion: Unhurried. A line draws itself at the pace of a hand; nothing snaps. Reduced motion keeps every kolam still.
voice.lede.icons: Thin line icons, the same weight as a line of flour.
voice.lede.button: Kaavi by day, turmeric by night, set on a small ledge that presses down. A success closes a small loop round the button.
voice.lede.voice: Plain and warm. Few words, said once.
voice.lede.404: No kolam at this door. Search, or go back to the first page.
voice.lede.morph: Draw it: dots first, then the line while it works, Closed when the loop joins - and the kolam opens.
voice.lede.checkbox: A dot until it is chosen; chosen, a ring closes round it.
voice.lede.card: A sheet of lime-washed card on the floor, lifting a little under the pointer.
voice.lede.divider: A chain of flour, one line round a row of dots.
voice.lede.progress: Dots laid first; the line follows them to the end.
voice.lede.spinner: Dots in a ring, brightening in the order they were laid.
voice.lede.skeleton: A swept floor with its dots set out, before the kolam.
voice.lede.toast: A slip of card; a success closes a loop beside it.
